description: Sud-Ouest : Canalisations TMD - TEREGA (ex TIGF) - Départements (surfacique) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Access to data is restricted to authorised persons. This data set contains the boundaries of the departments concerned by a transport pipeline of natural gas or similar gas, hydrocarbons and chemicals of the Terega carrier, supplied to DREAL pursuant to Article R554-48 of the Environmental Code and Article 16 of the Order of 5 March ...
